description: [runtime] Read an ABAP runtime dump by its dump_id or URI. Answers a summary — runtime error, exception, terminated program, time, user, and the source position where it terminated — and the parsed dump.

dump_id.description: The dump's id, or its URI as a dumps feed entry carries it.

response_mode.description: What is returned: "payload" — the parsed dump, "summary" — runtime error, exception, terminated program, time, user and termination position, "both" — summary and payload.

view.description: Dump view mode: default payload, summary section, or formatted long text.

name: RuntimeGetDumpById
